edges.mechanism: Product supplies 1 mg elemental lithium/day as orotate; a separate lithium supplement adds unmonitored lithium exposure. Orotate likely dissociates to Li+ like carbonate.
edges.evidence: Toxicology study, overdose case report, pharmacology commentary; no stacking study; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Additive lithium in a narrow-therapeutic-index drug; 1 mg/d is small relative to therapeutic doses but uncounted in serum-level management.
edges.evidence: Drug-interaction and toxicity reviews; inferred, no direct study

edges.mechanism: These reduce renal lithium clearance (thiazides +25-40% serum lithium); relevant mainly if the product is combined with other lithium sources.
edges.evidence: Reviews of lithium pharmacokinetic interactions at therapeutic doses; extrapolated to trace dose

edges.mechanism: Product supplies 15 mg zinc with no copper; added zinc induces enterocyte metallothionein and can cause copper-deficiency anemia, neutropenia and myelopathy.
edges.evidence: Case reports and reviews; dose-dependent, long-term exposure

edges.mechanism: Product supplies 28 mcg selenomethionine; stacking raises selenium intake. RCTs show no cancer benefit and slight excess type 2 diabetes, alopecia and dermatitis; possible U-shaped glucose response.
edges.evidence: Cochrane review of RCTs (high certainty for no cancer benefit); PRECISE RCT

edges.mechanism: Product supplies 200 mcg iodine (about 133% DV); additional iodine can push intake well above need, which can trigger hypo/hyperthyroidism or autoimmunity in susceptible people.
edges.evidence: Narrative/endocrine reviews

edges.mechanism: Iodine excess can worsen thyroid autoimmunity or cause dysfunction in pre-existing thyroid disease; selenium lowers TSH/TPOAb in Hashimoto, shifting tests.
edges.evidence: Reviews; MA of RCTs for selenium (GRADE moderate)

edges.mechanism: Calcium reduces levothyroxine absorption (20-25% at 500 mg calcium; product has 50 mg); iodine and selenium can alter thyroid tests. Separate dosing.
edges.evidence: PK crossover study; systematic review; inferred for this dose

edges.mechanism: Cumulative pyridoxine; neuropathy reports exist with low-dose products (1.4-100 mg per tablet), including a 6 mg/day multivitamin case.
edges.evidence: Pharmacovigilance case series and case report; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Duplicates B1, B2, niacinamide, B6, folate, B12, biotin and pantothenate; B6 is the main cumulative-toxicity concern.
edges.evidence: Pharmacovigilance and case data for B6

edges.mechanism: Product already supplies 67 mg d-alpha-tocopherol (447% DV); added vitamin E raises hemorrhagic stroke and prostate cancer signals seen in RCTs at higher doses.
edges.evidence: MAs of RCTs; SELECT RCT

edges.mechanism: Vitamin E is linked to hemorrhagic stroke; CoQ10 at 100 mg/d did not change INR in a crossover RCT.
edges.evidence: MA of RCTs (vitamin E); small RCT (CoQ10); no product study

edges.mechanism: Antiplatelet effect plus vitamin E-associated hemorrhagic stroke risk; additive bleeding risk plausible.
edges.evidence: MA of RCTs for vitamin E; combination not studied

edges.mechanism: Product supplies 2000 IU D3 (the VITAL dose); added D3 increases 25(OH)D without shown outcome benefit.
edges.evidence: Large RCTs and MA

edges.mechanism: Product supplies 300 mg NR; additional NR stacks NAD+ precursor dose. High-dose NR worsened early Parkinson outcomes in a phase 3 RCT.
edges.evidence: Dose-ranging RCT; NOPARK RCT

edges.mechanism: Same NAD+ salvage pathway as NR; duplicated precursor dosing without demonstrated added benefit.
edges.evidence: MAs of NR/NMN RCTs

edges.mechanism: Product supplies 100 mg/day fisetin; added fisetin (including intermittent senolytic dosing) stacks a flavonol with limited human safety data.
edges.evidence: Small RCTs, protocol and PK study; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Product supplies 50 mg ubiquinol; added CoQ10 duplicates dose; BP-lowering effect is small.
edges.evidence: MA of RCTs; bioavailability study

edges.mechanism: Product supplies 10 mg spermidine (as trihydrochloride); stacking has no outcome data, though 40 mg/d was safe for 28 days.
edges.evidence: Small RCTs/PK studies

edges.mechanism: Product supplies 20 mg glucoraphanin; another broccoli seed extract duplicates glucoraphanin/sulforaphane exposure. Thyroid function unaffected in a 12-week trial.
edges.evidence: RCTs of broccoli sprout beverages

edges.mechanism: Product supplies 3 mg boron; added boron raises total intake; long-term cumulative effects unstudied.
edges.evidence: Acute RCT only

edges.mechanism: Biotin interferes with streptavidin-biotin assays (falsely low troponin T/TSH, falsely high T3/vitamin D); 50 mcg/day is unlikely to interfere alone but adds to other biotin sources.
edges.evidence: In vitro spiking studies at high biotin concentrations

edges.mechanism: NR 1 g/day for 52 weeks worsened MDS-UPDRS and non-motor scores versus placebo in early Parkinson disease; relevance at 300 mg/day unknown.
edges.evidence: Phase 3 RCT (n=410)

edges.mechanism: Live Lactobacillus acidophilus (4 billion CFU); rare lactobacillus bacteremia/endocarditis mostly in immunocompromised, diabetic or valve-prosthesis patients.
edges.evidence: Case-report survey
